title: Changing locations?
content: I’ve always had very vivid dreams and for years have had consistent dreams of being in 3 different locations in my dreams. One was a forest with a house, a mall/hotel on the beach and my childhood house. As of recently, I have not dreamt of any of those locations. It almost feels as if I’m visiting an entirely different “world”. Along with that, the people in my dreams have changed. It’s very strange. I am going through a major move across states but that’s the only significant change in my non dream life. Has anyone else experienced this?
